## Image Generation — Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (2026-05-31)
Use `google/gemini-2.5-flash-image` via OpenRouter for infographic/image generation.
- Endpoint: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions
- Returns base64 PNG in `choices[].message.images[].image_url` (data:image/png;base64,...)
- Can generate infographic-style images with text baked in at readable social media sizes
- Prompt layout: "TOP SECTION (75%): [content]. BOTTOM SECTION (25%): clean background NO TEXT - reserved for QR codes"
- Specify large fonts: title 52-72px, subtitle 32-40px, body 24-32px — must be readable on mobile
- Much better quality than PIL-only composition for social media infographics
- Use `model: "google/gemini-2.5-flash-image"` with `stream: False`, timeout 300s

## Infographic Design Standards for Social Media (2026-05-31)
- Text sizes: Title 56-72px, Subtitle 36-44px, Headings 32-40px, Body 24-32px, Labels 20-28px
- Stats values: 48-64px bold
- NEVER use text smaller than 18px — unreadable on mobile
- QR codes in dedicated whitespace band at bottom (never overlaid on art)
- QR code sizes: 160-220px per code
- White cards behind QR codes for contrast
- Include URL text below each QR: "mifeco.com" and "amazon.com/s?k=bob+j+mills"
- Format outputs: square (1080x1080), portrait (1080x1350), landscape (1200x628), story (1080x1920)
- Business books → LinkedIn targeting (professional design)
- Fiction books → Facebook, X, Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok (bold, colorful)

## Last Page Manuscript Requirements (2026-05-31)
Last page of every manuscript MUST include:
1. Expanded thank-you blurb in Bob's voice
2. Two QR codes: mifeco.com + amazon.com/s?k=bob+j+mills
3. Expanded "more from Bob" statement
4. Complete list of ALL Bob J Mills books (update with each new book)
Current bibliography (17 books as of 2026-05-31):
- Business (3): AI That Works, The Crisis Ready Company, Owner's Manual for AI Agents
- Age of Lightships (4): Sunward Exodus, The Mercury Accord, Ghosts Beyond Neptune, The Last Photon Fleet
- Lunar Foundation (4): Moon Rock, Mooncoming, Waters End, Waters Horizon
- No Blue Sky (5): Built from Dust, The Oxygen Gamble, Rivers Under Mars, The Red Charter, The First Martian Nation
- Memoir (1): Tomorrow Remembered
